decision.reason: [ev-1c92d76c833b] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that the release will be v2.0 in August instead of v1.21, and points to PR #6514. It names no product subject, and it does not say what the PR actually changed (for example docs, roadmap or version metadata). It also says nothing about which environments are exposed or what happens if an operator does nothing. Without the PR content, or a statement that this is purely a scheduling note with no operational effect, no one can write the typed subject, change, applicability or consequence.
